items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: My first stint with Gil Evans I was playing French horn, and actually got the gig

ctx.x: Is that right? Now what prompted you to do that?

My first stint with Gil Evans I was playing French horn, and actually got the gig, oh I’ve got a lot of stories, how much tape have you got? But that’s one of my favorites, that’s the greatest. That’s one of the three or four greatest gigs I’ve ever had. I got it — Gil was doing a week at the Village Vanguard, and the horn player was coming in from New Jersey and he came all the way into town and he forgot his mouthpiece. And he was — I think he didn’t want to do it anyways because there was a lot of work in the…
